notes.title: The Light Brigade - Major Update 2.0 - Memories of War
notes.notes:
Hello Cosmic Friends. Today we're sharing a major update for our other VR game. The Light Brigade is a roguelike VR shooter, with realistic gunplay and immersive light magic, all set in a light fantasy WW1-like world, overcome by darkness.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1579880/The_Light_Brigade/

The new update brings new classes, new weapons, and a ton of new items to find in your runs. Please check it out and give it a try if you're looking for a new roguelike VR shooting game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23550802/d48b2842b7c91d21a58f5d149ab8152aa49cf533.gif

Till next time!

notes.title: Bugfix Patch
notes.notes:
Hello friends, we've had some reports of Windows Mixed Reality controllers. We just pushed a fix live, please let us know in the forums if you have any issues. Keep in mind we don't get any notifications of bug reports in steam reviews so if you have any problems posting in forums is the best place!

Patch Notes:
 fixed default steamvr bindings for WMR controllers
 disable hand tracking when WMR controllers dont report position

notes.title: Patch 8
notes.notes:
♫　BUG FIXES ♫

Here's a small update to fix a few bugs reported over the past few days. Thanks to everyone capturing footage and sending in logs, it helps a ton in tracking down the bugs quickly.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23550802/b36cc13173ae9f5f1cc881a33b64ebc4e66f2c90.png

Please note there seems to be an issue with SteamVR beta (1.6.2) causing input to fail. If you have an issue with missing hands and no input, revert to the stable SteamVR branch for now.

If you are running on Windows 7 and have issues launching, there is a branch win7_no_il2cpp while we wait for a Unity fix.

Changelist

 fixed spatialized audio issue
 fixed steam overlay causing bots to fly away
 fixed tutorial and waterfall scenes facing wrong way
 fixed oculus dash showing up on launch in some cases
 fixed button selection on map/menu for oculus controllers
 added input for rotate camera for small playspaces


stay funky

notes.title: PATCH 4 - VARIETY PATCH
notes.notes:
https://giant.gfycat.com/DeadCalculatingFlyinglemur.gif

♪ strategy enhancements bleep bleep ♪
 
Today's patch brings an overhaul of the spawn points in the strategy mode - this should make each match much more varied and overall the matches will be less of a long grind than before. You can use the toggles in the spaceship menu to select 1, 2, or 3 zones. The default will be two randomly chosen zones.
 
There's an experimental bot-group-follow button on the map screen too (top-right button). It is a little unclear right now, but basically you just select a group and press that and they will follow you around. They can be a little slow, but it mostly works - it's fun to get a squad and go hunting. Thoughts and feedback welcome.
 
Finally, we replaced the Audio SDK - the one we were using was extremely slow, so the CPU load should be much lower now, especially in late-game.
 
Changelist:

replace audio sdk (huge cpu performance improvement)
added zone randomization
added zone new spawn points
added drone follow button (experimental)
added setting for twitch user income multiplier
fixed various rare spawn issues
fixed drone selection increase/decrease counters
adjusted refinery speed faster
adjusted laser bot damage down
adjusted assault bot damage up
adjusted enemy travel speed down

 
PS. thanks for everyone who updates reviews since early access - it helps a lot
 
Report bugs or chat about the game here:
 
FAQ: http://steamcommunity.com/app/427240/discussions/0/352788917749583687/
Discord: https://discord.gg/013jLi10e03zz346o

Manual: https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B6f_9yIrlXIySllOOXR4aURNelU/view?usp=sharing

notes.title: PATCH RELEASE 2
notes.notes:
♪ FRESH AND SQUEEZY ♪
 
https://fat.gfycat.com/WhoppingJaggedIrrawaddydolphin.gif
https://gfycat.com/WhoppingJaggedIrrawaddydolphin
 
After 1.0 release we had a lot of new players join in the cosmic fun. We collected all the feedback since then and made some small additions and tweaks. Generally it's focused around improving the first-time experience - clearer tutorial phases, showing the main game objective, and showing where the enemy is.
 
The other changes are some quality of life changes - showing the reason an item is locked on the menu which is super useful (esp. first time play), and a very experimental 'save' feature. When you exit the game back to the ship (using the sphere-on-face), the game state is saved. There will be a sphere in the back of the ship and you can use that to pick up where you left off.
 
Thanks everyone for posting feedback and bug reports, we're trying to track down a couple more small issues, and something that is making late-game performance a bit poor. 
 
We're making some tweaks to make the twitch mode more accessible - you can read details about it below. If you end up streaming this feature is a lot of fun. Thanks to some players for helping test this so we could get some fixes in this patch.
 
Twitch Mode Guide: http://steamcommunity.com/app/427240/discussions/0/1290691937712292707/
 
Finally, we're working on a first-time users guide / manual. Write us some strategy tips you found useful in the forums, and we'll assemble a bunch for some 'tips' section at the end.
 
PS. reviews really help us since the vive userbase is super small - if you have a moment to write up your thoughts so people browsing can read about experiences with the game
 
 
Let us know if you have any issues in steam forums or drop by discord.
 
Changelist:

 added NEW save/resume game feature (experimental)
 added NEW tooltip to show menu locked reason
 added NEW HUD icon for enemy heart structure
 added tutorial improvements to clarify objectives
 added tutorial improvements to clarify tools
 added time of day / spawn zone text to spawn options menu
 added leaderboard stickers to ship
 added achievement stickers to ship
 added aliases for twitch mode spawns
 fixed hologram state issues on claimer building
 fixed slippy not taking damage from turret bullets
 fixed roller enemy damage taking (less in ball form)
 improved roller enemy animation changes to be faster
 improved bubble gun (stronger and larger bubbles)
 improved various twitch ui/ux
 improved difficulty curve for later waves in waterfall/desert wave modes

 
Report bugs or chat about the game here:
 
FAQ: http://steamcommunity.com/app/427240/discussions/0/352788917749583687/
Discord: https://discord.gg/013jLi10e03zz346o
 
Stay funky!

notes.title: Build Release Timing
notes.notes:
Hello friends, we're going to adjust the build timings again this week. After swapping to a one-week offset between dev-build and default branch, we realized that if there are bugs in the dev-build they'll still end up going into the default branch.

So now we'll be doing default branch updates every 2 weeks, and a dev-build update every week. The full patch notes and details will come on the default branch updates. 

If you want to follow the dev-build branch progress, and try out some work in progress features, come join us on the discord chat.

So stay tuned for a larger update in next weeks build then!

FAQ: http://steamcommunity.com/app/427240/discussions/0/352788917749583687/ 
Trello: https://trello.com/b/GZIV31BZ/cosmic-trip
